current.text: He signed a 2-year, 64 million extension with Miami plus a player option, on top of 30 million this season.
He is a lock to start for Miami, next to Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo.
Miami now has Giannis Antetokounmpo, so Wiggins is the third option behind him and Bam Adebayo, after long stretches as the number two option last season.
His usage was already under 20 and should take a hit next to Giannis. Experts expect him to do a bit less this season.
His minutes were around 28 to 29 a night over the final couple of months of last season.
Last season he shot 41% from three overall and 47% over the last 20 games. The expert does not expect that shooting to repeat.
He averaged over a steal and a block last season. The expert does not expect that to repeat, especially next to Giannis.
Experts do not want him in the top 100. They see him as fine around pick 107 to 109 and too high at ESPN rank 78.
Around pick 120 the expert would rather take upside flyers than Wiggins.
Tier rankings put him in tier seven as a safe pick. One ranks him above Tobias Harris and Aaron Gordon.
With Giannis on the team, Miami should move away from last season's very high pace and few ball screens.
Miami has a weak playoff schedule with a March 28 end: 4-3-3, 10 games in weeks 19 to 21.

durable.text: Well-rounded and predictable, with no weak category. Threes, steals and blocks are mild pluses, and blocks are good for his position.
Boring, low-ceiling profile with little upside and little downside.

note: Yahoo (rank 91, 6 USD value, 1.1 USD average cost) and ESPN (rank 85, 4 USD value, 1.5 USD average cost) put him a bit higher than the experts, who see him around pick 105 to 110 because his usage drops next to Giannis. With 144 players drafted, he is a 1 to 4 USD safe filler who fits any build. Our league paid 4 USD last season. Do not pay more for him, and early in the season check his minutes, his share of shots next to Giannis, and whether his three-point shooting and steals plus blocks hold up.
